mode.ui:title: Transmission Mode
mode.ui:description: Use Full or Partial transmission mode. Partial mode updates only changed values other than keyframes, reducing network traffic.

channelBehaviours.ui:title: Options for setting specific Feature or Channel behaviours
channelBehaviours.description: The key is either a ref to a Feature type OR a unierse:channel, to apply the behavior to. Default behavior is 'Highest'.
